condition: Aorto-enteric fistula (herald bleed after aortic graft)
summary: 70-year-old man with an open AAA repair and aortic graft in 2019 presents with a small haematemesis and melaena.

inputs.hpi: Vomited a cupful of fresh blood this morning and passed black stools; now feels well. Open AAA repair with an aortic graft in 2019. On aspirin.
surgicalHistory: Open AAA repair with aortic graft (2019)

mustInclude.note: Any GI bleed in a patient with an aortic graft is an aorto-enteric fistula until proven otherwise (ESVS 2020); a herald bleed precedes exsanguination.

guideline.name: ESVS 2020 clinical practice guidelines on the management of vascular graft and endograft infections
guideline.citation: Chakfé N et al. Eur J Vasc Endovasc Surg 2020;59:339-384

rationale: The zebra check must link a GI bleed with an aortic graft.
